<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 235.1395 corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+1 (~16 %) and an M+2 (~4–5 %) peak, consistent with ~15 carbons (13C contribution) and one sulfur atom (34S ≈ 4 %). A formula that matches the mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₅H₂₂S (monoisotopic mass = 234.144 Da, within typical MS error). Therefore the molecular formula is C15H22S.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H22S</final_answer>
